06. The Rule Maker 📏

8 MIN

Notice the rules

Players have to ride bicycles in cycleball.
Players can't use brakes in cycleball.
In pato, players can pass the ball with their right hand.
In octopush, players don't have to ride horses.

Think: Which phrase means necessary, allowed, not allowed, or not necessary?

Reveal grammar rule

have to = necessary; don't have to = not necessary; can = allowed/possible; can't = not allowed/impossible. Use the base verb after all four expressions.

Choose the correct form

Fix the mistakes

🎤 Make a rule, guess a sport

Tell your teacher three rules about a sport. Use have to, can, and can't. Can they guess?

07. Sports Festival Challenge 🏆

10 MIN
FINAL MISSION

Choose a sport for your school festival!

Your school has a sports hall and a playground, but no swimming pool or horses. Students are 14–16 years old. The activity must be fun, practical, and safe for beginners.

🧑‍💼

STUDENT: Consultant

Recommend a sport. Explain the equipment, rules, and reasons.

🗂️

TEACHER: Organiser

Ask questions and challenge the recommendation.

Compare two candidates

Useful: I think we should choose… / Players have to… / They can… but can't… / We need… / It's more practical because…

My festival proposal
